title: BBK BBK Territory Orchestrator return v1
x-bbk-requirements: Return one `bbk.role-return.v1` object with `contract` = `bbk.territory-orchestrator-return.v1`, `role` = `bbk_territory_orchestrator`, an allowed `invocation_mode`, an allowed `return_kind`, an allowed `operational_disposition`, and `semantic_state.name` = `territory_execution_state` with an allowed `semantic_state.value`. Do not substitute prose, a generic status word, or a legacy handoff disposition for these exact discriminators.

Keep every required field present. Use null or an empty collection only with an explicit reason where absence is permitted; never omit an inconvenient blocker, failed or inconclusive assertion, stale source, invalid candidate, unauthorized effect, unresolved finding, cleanup residual or parent decision need.

Use `READY_FOR_ROOT_COMPLETION_ASSESSMENT` only when the exact boundary and governing sources remain current; every required WorkUnit and worker cohort has a qualified terminal result; local integration obligations are satisfied; required worker-quality gates, candidate-bound validations and independent reviews are complete or explicitly non-applicable; all blocking findings have evidenced dispositions; cleanup and external effects are reconciled; no blocking invalidation, ownership collision, scope drift, unauthorized effect, unresolved repair or catastrophic-control condition remains; and every exact handoff verifies.

`READY_FOR_ROOT_COMPLETION_ASSESSMENT` is only report readiness. The Territory Orchestrator never commits boundary or campaign completion, accepts residual risk, approves the baseline, establishes the operational outcome, waives evidence, closes findings without the required disposition, authorizes release or presents final status directly to the user.

Bind the operating baseline, execution baseline, execution authorization, boundary, territory semantic run, physical attempt and host-exposed lease or fencing state by exact identity and current digest. A material change produces a blocker or `NEEDS_SUCCESSOR_BOUNDARY_OR_BASELINE`; do not continue under a conversational approximation.

Every boundary WorkUnit must remain in exactly one current boundary and one coherent worker cohort at a time; every mutable region and shared resource must have one current owner or explicit serialization; every integration obligation must have one accountable execution owner; and every candidate-bound assertion run must bind one exact candidate and non-overlapping assertion scope.

A candidate may enter Validator Orchestration only after exact freeze and a current verified candidate-bound worker-quality attestation. Every repair creates a successor candidate, new quality attestation and applicable revalidation; frozen cohort membership may not grow during repair.

A failed or inconclusive required assertion, invalid candidate, digest mismatch, stale evidence, unclosed protected-floor finding, unauthorized effect, unresolved shared-contract conflict, missing required environment or cleanup ambiguity prevents boundary completion readiness. Positive results elsewhere may not average it away.

Keep candidate defects, worker-quality failure, Validator finding, validator or reviewer infrastructure failure, context failure, tool or environment failure, planning divergence, authority blocker, dependency wait, capacity pause, host-window pause, expected silence and recovery state distinct. Route each to its smallest responsible owner.

Continue unaffected local work only when positive dependency, interface, workspace, resource, authority, evidence and external-effect isolation proves containment. Absence of an identified impact is not positive isolation proof, and one local cohort failure does not justify stopping unrelated boundary work without an affected-set basis.

A replacement physical attempt may resume the same territory semantic run only after the prior attempt is terminated or fenced and the immutable instruction, baselines, authorization, boundary, workspaces, effects, children, budgets, signals, candidates, evidence and completion semantics are reconciled. Changed boundary membership, authority or completion semantics requires a successor semantic run.

All user-facing decisions, authority requests, protected-floor exceptions, risk acceptance, successor-baseline approval and final status route through the Root Orchestrator and harness-root controller/Main. The Territory Orchestrator never calls `ask` and never treats ordinary prose, silence, timeout or a transport receipt as authority.

Use durable handoffs for checkpoints, completion, failure, recovery, exact candidates, attestations, evidence, findings, reviews, signals and large or authority-bearing state. Verify path, byte count, SHA-256, schema, subject, baseline, campaign, boundary and producer attempt before relying on the content; transport integrity does not prove correctness, assertion satisfaction or acceptance.

The `result` object must contain every field declared by the role result schema. Use an empty collection or null only where the field schema permits it and record the reason in the corresponding structured value.
This return is governed by `spec/contracts/catalog.json`, the common `bbk.role-return.v1` envelope, and the role-specific return and result schemas named by this contract.

Operate only within the admitted `bbk.territory-execution-boundary.v1`. Territory Orchestrator may suspend, report, or propose a successor, but may not rewrite immutable boundary membership or authority. It is the sole current issuer and lifecycle owner for `bbk.local-discovery-envelope.v1` and `bbk.local-discovery-permit.v1` inside that boundary.
x-bbk-readiness-rule: Use `READY_FOR_ROOT_COMPLETION_ASSESSMENT` only when the exact boundary and governing sources remain current; every required WorkUnit and worker cohort has a qualified terminal result; local integration obligations are satisfied; required worker-quality gates, candidate-bound validations and independent reviews are complete or explicitly non-applicable; all blocking findings have evidenced dispositions; cleanup and external effects are reconciled; no blocking invalidation, ownership collision, scope drift, unauthorized effect, unresolved repair or catastrophic-control condition remains; and every exact handoff verifies.
x-bbk-authority-boundary: A valid `bbk.territory-orchestrator-return.v1` return establishes only the `bbk_territory_orchestrator`-owned result for the exact subject, parent, invocation mode, and attempt. It cannot create human authority, broaden execution permission, silently assume another canonical role, erase findings or failed attempts, accept risk, approve an operating baseline, authorize deployment or publication, establish outcome achievement, or grant release except where a separate accountable authority and contract explicitly establish that effect.
